# Nutrition regression gates (Allen / Presley 2026-09-17)

Presley’s job is to stop Zoe/Bob from regressing working behavior.

## Meal recognition (chat program facts)
Before calling any meal-recognition / tip-dedupe / analyzeMealPortion change DONE:
- MUST pass exact dinner string with date commas:
  `📸 DINNER — Mon, Sep 14. 32oz water. 3 beef enchiladas flour tortillas. 2 cups green beans with olive oil.`
- Word on category list → recognized regardless of punctuation
- No amount → assume correct portion; wrong amount → advise correct
- Tim: FAIL job if “need protein/veg/fat” tips appear for that meal (except tortillas REMOVE in Phase 1)

Do not ship without regression test coverage for that string.

## Consistency (Allen 2026-09-17 evening)
Goal: fun in Allen’s voice + very consistent praise/advice/corrections across all phases, no matter which LLM.
- Program code owns nutrition facts (lists, missing, wrong portion, disallowed).
- LLM only voices those facts — never invents competing missing/wrong tips.
- Day-to-day quality must not swing with model mood. Tim fails jobs that let the model override program facts.
